extractor.note: Run after the chronology pass dated the course to Summer Semester 1924, which is what let it go on the ledger spine at all (gap-001).

coverage_note: The Introduction and Chapters 1-3 of the First Part (SS 9-17), where the concerning-character of world, the structure of concern and the self-concern of Dasein are set out, together with three checked absences later in the First Part. SS 18-26 carry term hits and have not been extracted.

units.claim: The world's coming-to-meet a living being is characterised as being-concerned: the way world is there for life at all is that it bears on it.
units.quote: This bearing-on, this being-concerned by the world one is in, Heidegger calls a definite mode of the world's *coming-to-meet* (*Begegnen*) in life.

units.claim: Inconsequentiality is a mode of the concerning-character and not its absence, which makes the concerning-character the more original determination of the surrounding world.
units.quote: Precisely in declaring something inconsequential, *Dasein* interprets the world as something that *could* concern it — so the concerning-character is the more original.

units.claim: Concern is glossed as a knowing-one's-way-about: taking care of something already says that one knows one's way within the circle of what one sets oneself.
units.quote: "I take care of something" already says that I know my way within the circle of what I set myself

units.claim: Concern is said to have the character of peras: its enactment is possible only because what is taken care of is there, and on this the determination Dasein is being-limited rests.
units.quote: the enactment of concern is possible only because what is taken care of is there, because concern does not grasp into the void, because concern has the character of *peras*

units.claim: The concerns of a Dasein form not a heap but a nexus determined by being-with-one-another, so that the manifold of concerns is structured in advance by the with.
units.quote: a manifold of concerns is given — not a heap but a *multiplicity with a nexus* determined by the character of being-with-one-another

units.claim: Being-in-the-world is determined as a mode of being that can take care of something in the world, and the concern is specified as the concern of a being that speaks.
units.quote: one mode of being-in-the-world such that it can *take care* of something in it, a concern of a being that *speaks*

units.claim: Concernful life is tied to hearing: the life in which speaking is co-present speaks in such a way that it hears itself.
units.quote: So the concernful life in which speaking is co-present speaks such that it *hears itself*.

units.claim: Concern is given a threefold temporal structure: it takes care of the not-yet-present, speaks of the already-happened and contemplates the now-there.
units.quote: Being as concern and concernful speaking is temporal: it takes care of the not-yet-present, speaks about the already-happened, contemplates the now-there.

units.claim: The being-in-the-world whose character is concern is one in which its own being is at issue: in taking care of what life deals with, it takes care of its own being.
units.quote: in this being-in-the-world *the being itself is at issue*: *eudaimonia* is taken care of — in taking care of what life deals with, it takes care of its own being

units.claim: The first of four ground-moments of Dasein drawn from hexis and arete states that Dasein as concern is care about itself, and that this self-concern is mostly inexplicit.
units.quote: in dealing about in the world, in dealing with other humans, the so-dealing *Dasein* takes care of itself, its being — *Dasein* as concern is care about itself, mostly inexplicit

absences.expected_because: The hexis of aletheuein is where phronesis is set out, and § 17 has just made Dasein as concern care about itself by way of hexis. The argument runs here in aletheuein and hexis instead, with no term of the family.
absences.note: This is the GA 19 pattern one semester earlier: the same near-absence at the phronesis material, in the same vocabulary. gap-004 asks whether that absence belongs to the course or to the commentary's rendering; GA 18 shows it is not peculiar to GA 19.

absences.expected_because: Being-resolved (proairesis) is treated here, and resoluteness is a mode of care wherever care is a formal structure. The section carries no term of the family, so the two are not yet joined.
absences.note: An absence that periodizes: in SS 1924 being-resolved is delimited against doxa, not referred to care.

absences.expected_because: Fear and courage are treated as pisteis and as pathe. Where care is a formal structure of Dasein, fear is a mode of disposedness grounded in it, as GA 20 § 30 has it; here the analysis is carried by pistis and composure instead.
absences.note: The neighbouring section f) on the disposedness in being-afraid does carry the vocabulary, so this is an absence within a treatment of fear, not a gap in the course's attention to it.
